sections.title: Species traits
lines: Large Monstrous Humanoid. +8 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, −2 Charisma. Land speed 40 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. and +4 natural armor.
Large size imposes −1 on attacks and AC, −4 to Hide, and grants +4 on grapple checks. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. The player entry specifies twice Medium lifting and carrying limits.
+8 racial bonus on Jump. A 40-ft. land speed adds another +4 under the core Jump rule. Jumping is part of movement. A running jump needs 20 ft. of run-up, or the DC doubles.

Two front claws are natural weapons that deal 1d6 piercing and slashing damage each before Strength. With a one-handed weapon, the player entry allows one secondary claw at −5 on the attack roll and half the Strength bonus to damage.
Proficient with all simple weapons and shields.

Five racial Hit Dice (5d8) grant BAB +5, base Fortitude +1, Reflex +4, Will +4, and two feats. Racial skill points are eight times (2 + Intelligence modifier), minimum 1 point per Hit Die before the first-Hit-Die multiplier. Racial class skills are Hide, Jump, Listen, Move Silently, Spot, and Survival.
A wemic can select Spirited Charge or Trample without meeting the normal prerequisites and apply the feat to its own melee attacks, as the player entry describes.
Common and Sylvan are automatic. Bonus languages are by region. Favored class Barbarian. LA +3 gives ECL 8 before class levels.
This profile uses the 2003 player rules and the 2004 conversion’s space and reach. The earlier monster entry has a different weapon-and-claw routine.

sections.title: Original NPC · Tavaro Sunmane
lines: Motive. Secure a rope across the gap before the water rises.
Hook. Tavaro points out a flat approach to the far-side anchor.
Wemic gully guide, racial Hit Dice only · Provisional CR 3. ECL 8 (5 racial HD, LA +3). · Large Monstrous Humanoid

sections.title: Original NPC · Nasha Reedstep
lines: Motive. Keep the approach clear until the crew reaches the other bank.
Hook. Nasha waits on the wider bank where there is room to turn.
Wemic ford guard, Barbarian 1 · Provisional CR 4. ECL 9 (5 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +3). · Large Monstrous Humanoid
AC 19 · HP 51 (5d8+1d12+18) · Speed 50 ft. with fast movement; base 40 ft.
